messages:
Aisha: Quick follow-up from the morning postmortem — recurring throughput dips on large-batch requests. I pulled the action list and SLO suggestions. TL;DR: tweak autoscaler, add throughput SLO, small infra mitigations.

Carlos: paste actions please. I missed the call.

Aisha: 1) Autoscaler debounce + safety cap (owner: Carlos) 2) KV shard prewarm on rotation (owner: Ravi) 3) Throughput SLO proposal + dashboard (owner: Tess) 4) Runbook updates for GPU preemptions (owner: Carlos)

Ravi: I can own shard prewarm. Plan: prototype a prewarm hook in the node init, test with canary job. Est timeline: prototype 3 days, staging validation 1 week.

Carlos: autoscaler debounce: current is 30s window which causes scale thrash when GC spikes coincide. Proposal: 90s debounce + scale-in cooldown 5m and a hard cap for burst traffic. I'll sketch changes and bench.

Tess: for SLOs, current throughput SLO is not explicit. Propose a new composite: route "generate-large" throughput >= 120 req/min per shard (95% of 5m windows) and p95 latency < 250ms. This gives both capacity and latency guardrails.

Aisha: I like composite. Also propose changing error budget review cadence for throughput-critical routes to weekly until stabilized.

Carlos: small nit: use rolling 5m windows for the throughput percentage, not fixed 5m buckets. Also we should use synthetic traffic during off-peak to validate.

Tess: agreed. dashboard panels to add:
```
- throughput: count(route=generate-large) / 5m rolling 1m
- p95 latency(route=generate-large) over 5m
- pct_5m_windows_below_120 = count(5m windows with throughput < 120)/count(5m windows)*100
```
I'll wire these up and flag alert thresholds for review.

Ravi: runbook note for prewarm: on deploy rotation run a lightweight warm request set to populate KV per-shard. Will include rollback steps if warm causes overload.

alert-bot: Alert rule created (draft): generate-large_throughput_drop — fires when pct_5m_windows_below_120 > 2% over 30m. Owner: Tess.

Tess: I'll own the alert. Can we link the runbook from the alert? otherwise oncall will scramble.

Carlos: yes will add runbook links and a short checklist: check autoscaler logs -> check recent prewarm runs -> check GPU preemption events.

Aisha: regarding error budget reset — product asked for an emergency reset because a few paying customers were affected. Recommendation: do not reset silently. Options: (1) 0% reset + org exception to allow hotfix deploys, (2) 50% partial reset with documented rationale.

Ravi: prefer partial 50% so we don't remove guardrails completely. we'll add approval step in governance doc.

Carlos: timeline recap: autoscaler change PR by Fri, prewarm prototype by Thu, dashboard + alerts by Wed, runbook edits by end of week. Weekly error budget reviews start next Mon.

Aisha: Scheduling followup meeting: Mon 09:30 to review prototype metrics and synthetic traffic results. Invite sent.

slo-bot: New SLO draft created: generate-large_composite_v1. Reviewers: eng-oncall, eng-sre, product. Use /slo-approve to record approvals.

Tess: I'll post the dashboard link in the postmortem doc once panels are live.

Carlos: ack. pushing autoscaler PR today for initial comments.

Ravi: ack — will post canary results to thread after staging run.

Aisha: thanks all. Please update the postmortem checklist with PR links and test results so incident-bot reminder won't nag.

alert-bot: Reminder: open postmortem items older than 21 days will trigger a notification to owners.

Carlos: noted. closing for now. :white_check_mark:
